notes.title: Cozy Cabin: Coffee Boutique Free Demo!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone!

A few days ago the Cozy Cabin: Coffee Boutique store page went live here on steam, along with a free demo you can download and play today! 

If you haven't already, try the game out and submit your feedback here!

We at Poly Blossom began development on Cozy Cabin: Coffee Boutique just over a year and a half ago and we are very proud with the demo we have to present to you today. We are a very small team, but we are dedicated to bringing you the most complete version of Cozy Cabin that is possible. There are so many features planned to come to the game and we can't wait for you to play with them.

Have Fun Brewing!
